title: 第14章 我想追回她！
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
玉凝抱走孩子之后，陆沉和张帆又聊了一会。

    正当他要离开时，突然收到了王峰的传信，让他出来聚一聚，林天张帆也都去。

    “王师兄这是？”张帆有些疑惑。

    “我也不知道，也许是有什么事吧，咱们去看看！”

    “玉凝，你……”

    “我就不去了，今天宝儿困了，得回去睡觉。”

    “那行，我一会就回来！”

    张帆说完，就和陆沉一起离开了。

    玉凝回到洞府，把宝儿放进摇篮，坐在一旁静静看着他。

    “宝儿，你知不知道，你和你陆沉师伯，长了一模一样的鼻子？”

    宝儿睡得正香，自然没法回答。

    玉凝沉默了很久。

    师娘不对劲，姜师姐是受害者，那么只要自己对比一下姜师姐，师娘的孩子……

    一个大胆的念头涌上心头。

    ……

    陆沉和张帆到的时候，林天，庄静白和王峰已经在聊天了。

    其实庄静白本来也不想来的，但是得知陆沉要来之后，她这才跟着过来。

    这几天，天天用被子，上面已经没味道了，她也已经开始用留影石了，尤其是当初她被陆沉压在桌子上那次。

    现在看到陆沉出现，不知为何，她的心跳有些加速，脸也有些红润。

    “王师兄。”陆沉拱手坐下，余光扫过庄静白，后者对着他眨了眨眼，他只当没看见她的异样。

    “人都到齐了。”王峰给几人倒了杯酒。

    他今日看着憔悴了不少，胡茬也冒了出来，全然没了往日那个王家炼丹天才的意气风发。

    “今天叫你们来，是有件事想跟你们说。”

    “我后悔了。”

    四个字，声音不大，却像一块石头扔进了平静的水面。

    “王师兄……”

    “你们别劝，让我把话说完。”

    “分开这些天，我一直在想……想怀玉，想女儿。白天想，晚上也想，闭上眼睛就是她们娘俩的脸。”

    王峰端起酒杯，一饮而尽。

    “虽然我女儿……她不是我亲生的，可她是我养大的。我怎么可能会没有感情呢？她第一次叫我爹爹，她哭她笑……”

    他说不下去了，抬手捂住脸。

    众人都没有说话。
content_en:
After Yu Ning took the child away, Lu Chen and Zhang Fan chatted for a while.

Just as he was about to leave, he suddenly received a message from Wang Feng, asking him to come out and get together. Lin Tian and Zhang Fan were also there.

"Senior Brother Wang, what is this?" Zhang Fan was a little confused.

"I don't know, maybe there's something wrong, let's go take a look!"

"Yu Ning, you..."

"I won't go. Bao'er is sleepy today and has to go back to sleep."

"Okay, I'll be back in a minute!"

After Zhang Fan finished speaking, he left with Lu Chen.

Yu Ning returned to the cave, put Bao'er in the cradle, and sat aside to watch him quietly.

"Bao'er, do you know that you and your uncle Lu Chen have exactly the same nose?"

Bao'er was sleeping soundly, so naturally he couldn't answer.

Yu Ning was silent for a long time.

Something is wrong with Senior Wife, Senior Sister Jiang is the victim, so just compare yourself to Senior Sister Jiang, Senior Wife’s child...

A bold idea came to mind.

…

When Lu Chen and Zhang Fan arrived, Lin Tian, Zhuang Jingbai and Wang Feng were already chatting.

In fact, Zhuang Jingbai didn't want to come at first, but after learning that Lu Chen was coming, she followed him.

In the past few days, she had used the quilt every day, and it had no smell anymore. She had also started to use the photo stone, especially that time when she was pressed on the table by Lu Chen.

Now seeing Lu Chen appear, for some reason her heartbeat accelerated and her face became rosy.

"Senior Brother Wang." Lu Chen sat down with his hands folded, and glanced at Zhuang Jingbai from the corner of his eye. The latter blinked at him, and he just pretended that he didn't see anything strange about her.

"Everyone is here." Wang Feng poured a glass of wine for several people.

He looks a lot more haggard today, with stubble appearing on his face, and he has completely lost the high-spiritedness of the Wang family's alchemy genius in the past.

"I called you here today because I have something to tell you."

"I regret it."

Four words, not loud, but like a stone thrown into the calm water.

"Senior Brother Wang..."

"Don't try to persuade me, just let me finish."

"These days we have been apart, I have been thinking... about pregnant jade and my daughter. I think about it during the day and at night. When I close my eyes, it is the faces of the two of them."

Wang Feng picked up the wine glass and drank it in one gulp.

"Although my daughter... she is not my biological child, she was raised by me. How could I be emotionless? The first time she called me daddy, she cried and she laughed..."

He couldn't speak anymore and raised his hands to cover his face.

No one spoke.
title_en: Chapter 14 I want to get her back!
